---


Implemented email change confirmation:

1. Updated `verify-email-form.tsx` to include `emailRedirectTo` pointing to `/auth/confirm-email-change` when calling `updateUser`.
2. Created `/auth/confirm-email-change/route.ts` that:
   - Extracts the `code` from the URL query parameters
   - Exchanges it for a session using `exchangeCodeForSession`
   - Redirects to `/protected` on success, or to the error page on failure

The endpoint follows the same pattern as your OAuth callback route, using `exchangeCodeForSession` for the PKCE flow (code-based, not token_hash).

When users click the email link, they'll be redirected to `/auth/confirm-email-change?code=...`, the code will be exchanged for a session, and they'll be redirected to the protected page.

Make sure `/auth/confirm-email-change` is added to your Supabase redirect URLs in the dashboard (or in your local config).

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm() {\nconst handleSendOTP = async \n {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n  const handleVerifyOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Verify OTP code for email change/linking\n      // Use type 'email_change' because we used updateUser() to initiate the flow\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // to the current authenticated user instead of creating a new user\n      const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n        email: email.trim(),\n        token: otpCode.trim(),\n        type: \"email_change\",\n      });\n\n      if (verifyError) {\n        setError(verifyError.message || \"Invalid OTP code\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Refresh session to ensure identities are updated\n      await supabase.auth.refreshSession();\n\n      // Success - redirect to protected page\n      router.push(\"/protected\");\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Card&gt;\n      &lt;CardHeader&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \"@/components/verify-email-form\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Email verification page\n * Users must link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\n */\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has email identity\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/protected\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-sm\"&gt;\n        &lt;VerifyEmailForm /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "config: { private: true }\n})\n  .on('broadcast', { event: 'message_created' }, handleMessage)\n  .on('broadcast', { event: 'user_joined' }, handleUserJoined)\n\n// Set auth before subscribing\nawait supabase.realtime.setAuth()\n\n// Subscribe after auth is set\nawait channel.subscribe()\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Enhanced Security: Private-Only Channels\n**Enable private-only channels** in Realtime Settings (Dashboard &gt; Project Settings &gt; Realtime Settings) to enforce authorization on all channels and prevent public channel access. This setting requires all clients to use &#96;private: true&#96; and proper authentication, providing additional security for production applications.\n\n## Error Handling &amp; Reconnection\n\n### Automatic Reconnection (Built-in)\n**Supabase Realtime client handles reconnection automatically:**\n- Built-in exponential backoff for connection retries\n- Automatic channel rejoining after network interruptions\n- Configurable reconnection timing via &#96;reconnectAfterMs&#96; option\n\n### Channel States\nThe client automatically manages these states:\n- **&#96;SUBSCRIBED&#96;** - Successfully connected and receiving messages\n- **&#96;TIMED_OUT&#96;** - Connection attempt timed out\n- **&#96;CLOSED&#96;** - Channel is closed\n- **&#96;CHANNEL_ERROR&#96;** - Error occurred, client will automatically retry\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// Client automatically reconnects with built-in logic\nconst supabase = createClient('URL', 'ANON_KEY', {\n  realtime: {\n    params: {\n      log_level: 'info',\n      reconnectAfterMs: 1000 // Custom reconnection timing\n    }\n  }\n})\n\n// Simple connection state monitoring\nchannel.subscribe((status, err) =&gt; {\n  switch (status) {\n    case 'SUBSCRIBED':\n      console.log('Connected (or reconnected)')\n      break\n    case 'CHANNEL_ERROR':\n      console.error('Channel error:', err)\n      // Client will automatically retry - no manual intervention needed\n      break\n    case 'CLOSED':\n      console.log('Channel closed')\n      break\n  }\n})\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Performance &amp; Scaling Guidelines\n\n### Channel Structure Optimization\n- Use one channel per logical scope (&#96;room:123&#96;, not &#96;user:456:room:123&#96;)\n- Shard high-volume topics: &#96;chat:shard:1&#96;, &#96;chat:shard:2&#96;",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { cn } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport {\n  Card,\n  CardContent,\n  CardDescription,\n  CardHeader,\n  CardTitle,\n} from \"@/components/ui/card\";\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\";\nimport { Label } from \"@/components/ui/label\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\nexport function ForgotPasswordForm({\n  className,\n  ...props\n}: React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef&lt;\"div\"&gt;) {\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState(\"\");\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleForgotPassword = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const supabase = createClient();\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      // The url which will be included in the email. This URL needs to be configured in your redirect URLs in the Supabase dashboard at https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/_/auth/url-configuration\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, {\n        redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/update-password&#96;,\n      });\n      if (error) throw error;\n      setSuccess(true);\n    } catch (error: unknown) {\n      setError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"An error occurred\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className={cn(\"flex flex-col gap-6\", className)} {...props}&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,",

        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has an email identity linked\n * (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n * @returns true if user has an email identity, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasEmailIdentity(): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (error || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth)\n  // User identities include: email, google, etc.\n  // We need at least one email identity\n  const identities = user.identities || [];\n  \n  // Check if any identity is an email identity (not OAuth)\n  return identities.some(\n    (identity) =&gt; identity.provider === \"email\"\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm() {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Sends OTP code to the provided email\n   * Uses updateUser to add email identity to the current authenticated user\n   * This is the correct way to link an email identity to an existing OAuth account\n   */\n  const handleSendOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Validate email format\n      if (!email || !email.includes(\"@\")) {\n        setError(\"Please enter a valid email address\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Use updateUser to add email identity to existing authenticated user\n      // This sends a verification link to the email address\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // Note: This adds the email as a secondary identity, not changing the primary email\n      const { data: updateData, error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser({\n        email: email.trim(),\n        options: {\n          emailRedirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/confirm-email-change&#96;,\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (updateError) {\n        // If email already exists, that's actually fine - it means it might already be linked\n        // or we need to handle it differently\n        if (updateError.message?.includes(\"already registered\")) {\n          setError(\"This email is already registered. Please use a different email or sign in with that email.\");\n        } else {\n          setError(updateError.message || \"Failed to send OTP code\");\n        }\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Move to OTP verification step\n      setStep(\"otp\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,\n    picture: user.user_metadata.avatar_url  // Default to Google picture\n  })\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 4: Middleware Validation\n\nQuery database for profile linked to current auth.user and check &#96;removed_access IS NULL&#96; on every request to protected routes.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Middleware check\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id, role, removed_access')\n  .eq('user_id', user.id)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) redirect('/auth/verify-work-email');\nif (profile.removed_access) redirect('/auth/access-revoked');\n// User has active access, continue...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Estimated Complexity\n\n| Task | Complexity | Lines of Code |\n\n|------|------------|---------------|\n\n| Delete old auth files | Trivial | -500 lines |\n\n| Security lockdown config | Trivial | ~20 lines TOML |\n\n| Database migration | Low | ~40 lines SQL (users, profiles, indexes) |\n\n| Constants + validation | Trivial | ~25 lines |\n\n| Server actions (auth logic) | Medium | ~60 lines |\n\n| Middleware update | Medium | ~50 lines (includes DB queries) |\n\n| Google login page | Low | ~30 lines |\n\n| Work email form + linking | Medium | ~120 lines |\n\n| Pending approval page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n| Access revoked page | Low | ~20 lines |\n\n**Total new code**: ~385 lines (vs ~500 lines deleted)\n\n## Separation of Concerns\n\n### Supabase (Auth + Storage Only)\n\n- **Authentication**: Google OAuth flow, session management, OTP emails\n- **Database**: Store profiles and users data (no RLS - Next.js handles access control)\n- **No business logic**: No custom hooks, no stored procedures, no triggers, no functions\n\n### Next.js (All Business Logic)\n\n- **Middleware**: Profile verification, access checks, role-based routing\n- **Server Actions**: Profile linking, access revocation\n- **Validation**: Domain validation, input sanitization, business rules\n- **Authorization**: Role hierarchy checks, permission enforcement\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                         Next.js                                  │",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/work_email_auth_system_467a2b18.plan.md",
        "range": {

          "endPosition": {

        },
        "contents": "## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer Only)\n\n1. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n2. **No RLS or Functions**:\n\n   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions",

1. Creates a `NextResponse` that captures cookies set during `exchangeCodeForSession`
2. Copies all cookies from the Supabase response to the redirect response
3. Returns the redirect with cookies included

        "contents": "config: { private: true }\n})\n  .on('broadcast', { event: 'message_created' }, handleMessage)\n  .on('broadcast', { event: 'user_joined' }, handleUserJoined)\n\n// Set auth before subscribing\nawait supabase.realtime.setAuth()\n\n// Subscribe after auth is set\nawait channel.subscribe()\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Enhanced Security: Private-Only Channels\n**Enable private-only channels** in Realtime Settings (Dashboard &gt; Project Settings &gt; Realtime Settings) to enforce authorization on all channels and prevent public channel access. This setting requires all clients to use &#96;private: true&#96; and proper authentication, providing additional security for production applications.\n\n## Error Handling &amp; Reconnection\n\n### Automatic Reconnection (Built-in)\n**Supabase Realtime client handles reconnection automatically:**\n- Built-in exponential backoff for connection retries\n- Automatic channel rejoining after network interruptions\n- Configurable reconnection timing via &#96;reconnectAfterMs&#96; option\n\n### Channel States\nThe client automatically manages these states:\n- **&#96;SUBSCRIBED&#96;** - Successfully connected and receiving messages\n- **&#96;TIMED_OUT&#96;** - Connection attempt timed out\n- **&#96;CLOSED&#96;** - Channel is closed\n- **&#96;CHANNEL_ERROR&#96;** - Error occurred, client will automatically retry\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// Client automatically reconnects with built-in logic\nconst supabase = createClient('URL', 'ANON_KEY', {\n  realtime: {\n    params: {\n      log_level: 'info',\n      reconnectAfterMs: 1000 // Custom reconnection timing\n    }\n  }\n})\n\n// Simple connection state monitoring\nchannel.subscribe((status, err) =&gt; {\n  switch (status) {\n    case 'SUBSCRIBED':\n      console.log('Connected (or reconnected)')\n      break\n    case 'CHANNEL_ERROR':\n      console.error('Channel error:', err)\n      // Client will automatically retry - no manual intervention needed\n      break\n    case 'CLOSED':\n      console.log('Channel closed')\n      break\n  }\n})\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Performance &amp; Scaling Guidelines\n\n### Channel Structure Optimization\n- Use one channel per logical scope (&#96;room:123&#96;, not &#96;user:456:room:123&#96;)\n- Shard high-volume topics: &#96;chat:shard:1&#96;, &#96;chat:shard:2&#96;",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\n/**\n * Google OAuth login button component\n * Handles both sign-in and sign-up flows seamlessly\n */\nexport function GoogleLoginButton() {\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleGoogleLogin = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    const supabase = createClient();\n\n    try {\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider: \"google\",\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/callback&#96;,\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (error) {\n        console.error(\"Google OAuth error:\", error);\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n      // Note: User will be redirected to Google, so we don't reset loading state here\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Unexpected error:\", error);\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Button\n      type=\"button\"\n      onClick={handleGoogleLogin}\n      disabled={isLoading}\n      className=\"w-full\"\n      variant=\"outline\"\n    &gt;\n      {isLoading ? (\n        \"Connecting...\"\n      ) : (\n        &lt;&gt;\n          &lt;svg\n            className=\"mr-2 h-4 w-4\"\n            aria-hidden=\"true\"\n            focusable=\"false\"\n            data-prefix=\"fab\"\n            data-icon=\"google\"\n            role=\"img\"\n            xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\"\n            viewBox=\"0 0 488 512\"\n          &gt;\n            &lt;path\n              fill=\"currentColor\"\n              d=\"M488 261.8C488 403.3 391.1 504 248 504 110.8 504 0 393.2 0 256S110.8 8 248 8c66.8 0 123 24.5 166.3 64.9l-67.5 64.9C258.5 52.6 94.3 52.6 94.3 256s164.2 203.4 254.5 203.4c56.5 0 86.9-31.7 98.1-72.5 10.7-38.6 4.1-66.1-3.5-88.3H248v-94.8h240z\"\n            &gt;&lt;/path&gt;\n          &lt;/svg&gt;\n          Continue with Google\n        &lt;/&gt;\n      )}\n    &lt;/Button&gt;\n  );\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {

            "column": 1

        },
        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (code) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n\n    if (!error) {\n      // Check if user has email identity linked\n      // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n      const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n      const redirectTo = next || (hasEmail ? \"/protected\" : \"/auth/verify-email\");\n      redirect(redirectTo);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to error page if something went wrong\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=Failed to authenticate with Google&#96;);\n}",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";",
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {

        "contents": "- **One topic per feature**: &#96;game:123:moves&#96;, &#96;game:123:chat&#96;\n\n## Naming Conventions\n\n### Topics (Channels)\n- **Pattern:** &#96;scope:entity&#96; or &#96;scope:entity:id&#96;\n- **Examples:** &#96;room:123:messages&#96;, &#96;game:456:moves&#96;, &#96;user:789:notifications&#96;\n- **Public channels:** &#96;public:announcements&#96;, &#96;global:status&#96;\n\n### Events\n- **Pattern:** &#96;entity_action&#96; (snake_case)\n- **Examples:** &#96;message_created&#96;, &#96;user_joined&#96;, &#96;game_ended&#96;, &#96;status_changed&#96;\n- **Avoid:** Generic names like &#96;update&#96;, &#96;change&#96;, &#96;event&#96;\n\n## Client Setup Patterns\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// Basic setup\nconst supabase = createClient('URL', 'ANON_KEY')\n\n// Channel configuration\nconst channel = supabase.channel('room:123:messages', {\n  config: {\n    broadcast: { self: true, ack: true },\n    presence: { key: 'user-session-id', enabled: true },\n    private: true  // Required for RLS authorization\n  }\n})\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Configuration Options\n\n#### Broadcast Configuration\n- **&#96;self: true&#96;** - Receive your own broadcast messages\n- **&#96;ack: true&#96;** - Get acknowledgment when server receives your message\n\n#### Presence Configuration\n- **&#96;enabled: true&#96;** - Enable presence tracking for this channel. This flag is set automatically by client library if &#96;on('presence')&#96; is set.\n- **&#96;key: string&#96;** - Custom key to identify presence state (useful for user sessions)\n\n#### Security Configuration\n- **&#96;private: true&#96;** - Require authentication and RLS policies\n- **&#96;private: false&#96;** - Public channel (default, not recommended for production)\n\n## Frontend Framework Integration\n\n### React Pattern\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nconst channelRef = useRef(null)\n\nuseEffect(() =&gt; {\n  // Check if already subscribed to prevent multiple subscriptions",

        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has an email identity linked\n * (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n * @returns true if user has an email identity, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasEmailIdentity(): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (error || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth)\n  // User identities include: email, google, etc.\n  // We need at least one email identity\n  const identities = user.identities || [];\n  \n  // Check if any identity is an email identity (not OAuth)\n  return identities.some(\n    (identity) =&gt; identity.provider === \"email\"\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "### Channel Structure Optimization\n- Use one channel per logical scope (&#96;room:123&#96;, not &#96;user:456:room:123&#96;)\n- Shard high-volume topics: &#96;chat:shard:1&#96;, &#96;chat:shard:2&#96;\n- Ensure you have enough connections set in your pool, you can refer to [Realtime Settings](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/realtime/settings) and the option &#96;Database connection pool size&#96; to set it.\n\n## Debugging\n\n### Enhanced Logging\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nconst supabase = createClient(url, key, {\n  realtime: {\n    params: { log_level: 'info' }\n  }\n})\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Migration from Postgres Changes\n\n### Step 1: Replace Client Code\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// ❌ Remove postgres_changes\nconst oldChannel = supabase.channel('changes').on('postgres_changes', { event: '*', schema: 'public', table: 'messages' }, callback)\n\n// ✅ Replace with broadcast\nconst room_id = \"room_id\" // or any other identifier that you use in the trigger function\nconst newChannel = supabase.channel(&#96;messages:${room_id}:changes&#96;, {\n  config: { private: true }\n})\n.on('broadcast', { event: 'INSERT' }, callback)\n.on('broadcast', { event: 'DELETE' }, callback)\n.on('broadcast', { event: 'UPDATE' }, callback)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 2: Add Database Trigger (Only if using broadcast)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE TRIGGER messages_broadcast_trigger\n  AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON messages\n  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION notify_table_changes();\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: Setup Authorization (Only if using broadcast)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE POLICY \"users_can_receive_broadcasts\" ON realtime.messages\n  FOR SELECT TO authenticated USING (true);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## LLM Implementation Guidelines\n\n### When Generating Code\n1. **Prefer using &#96;broadcast&#96; over &#96;postgres_changes&#96;** - Never suggest &#96;postgres_changes&#96;\n2.**Include state checking** - Check channel state before subscribing\n3. **Add cleanup logic** - Include unsubscribe in all examples\n4. **Suggest proper naming** - Use consistent topic/event conventions\n5. **Include error handling** - Add reconnection patterns\n6. **Recommend indexing** - When RLS policies are used\n7. **Framework-agnostic** - Adapt patterns to user's framework\n8. **Inform users to prefer the usage of private channels only** - users can refer to [Realtime Settings](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/realtime/settings) to enable it.",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \"@/components/verify-email-form\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Email verification page\n * Users must link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\n */\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has email identity\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/protected\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-sm\"&gt;\n        &lt;VerifyEmailForm /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

---


Set `/auth/confirm-email-change` in three places:

1. In `components/verify-email-form.tsx` (line 56) — as the `emailRedirectTo` option when calling `updateUser`:
```typescript
emailRedirectTo: `${window.location.origin}/auth/confirm-email-change`,
```

2. In `supabase/config.toml` (lines 157-158, 163) — added to the `additional_redirect_urls` whitelist:
```toml
"http://localhost:3000/auth/confirm-email-change",
"https://localhost:3000/auth/confirm-email-change",
"http://127.0.0.1:3000/auth/confirm-email-change",
```

3. Created the route handler at `app/auth/confirm-email-change/route.ts` — this endpoint handles the callback and exchanges the code for a session.

The redirect URL must be:
- Specified in `emailRedirectTo` (tells Supabase where to redirect)
- Whitelisted in `additional_redirect_urls` (Supabase security requirement)
- Have a route handler to process the callback (exchanges code for session)

All three are in place. After restarting Supabase, the email link should redirect to `/auth/confirm-email-change?code=...` instead of the root URL.

            "text": "# This hook runs before a new user is created and allows developers to reject the request based on the incoming user object.",
            "lineNumber": 271
          },
          {
            "text": "# [auth.hook.before_user_created]",
            "lineNumber": 272
          },
          {
            "text": "# enabled = true",
            "lineNumber": 273
          },
          {
            "text": "# uri = \"pg-functions://postgres/auth/before-user-created-hook\"",
            "lineNumber": 274
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 275
          },
          {
            "text": "# This hook runs before a token is issued and allows you to add additional claims based on the authentication method used.",
            "lineNumber": 276
          },
          {
            "text": "# [auth.hook.custom_access_token]",
            "lineNumber": 277
          },
          {
            "text": "# enabled = true",
            "lineNumber": 278
          },
          {
            "text": "# uri = \"pg-functions://&lt;database&gt;/&lt;schema&gt;/&lt;hook_name&gt;\"",
            "lineNumber": 279
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 280
          },
          {
            "text": "# Configure one of the supported SMS providers: &#96;twilio&#96;, &#96;twilio_verify&#96;, &#96;messagebird&#96;, &#96;textlocal&#96;, &#96;vonage&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 281
          },
          {
            "text": "[auth.sms.twilio]",
            "lineNumber": 282
          },
          {
            "text": "enabled = false",
            "lineNumber": 283
          },
          {
            "text": "account_sid = \"\"",
            "lineNumber": 284
          },
          {
            "text": "message_service_sid = \"\"",
            "lineNumber": 285
          },
          {
            "text": "# DO NOT commit your Twilio auth token to git. Use environment variable substitution instead:",
            "lineNumber": 286
          },
          {
            "text": "auth_token = \"env(SUPABASE_AUTH_SMS_TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN)\"",
            "lineNumber": 287
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 288
          },
          {
            "text": "# Multi-factor-authentication is available to Supabase Pro plan.",
            "lineNumber": 289
          },
          {
            "text": "[auth.mfa]",
            "lineNumber": 290
          },
          {
            "text": "# Control how many MFA factors can be enrolled at once per user.",
            "lineNumber": 291
          },
          {
            "text": "max_enrolled_factors = 10",
            "lineNumber": 292
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 293
          },
          {
            "text": "# Control MFA via App Authenticator (TOTP)",
            "lineNumber": 294
          },
          {
            "text": "[auth.mfa.totp]",
            "lineNumber": 295
          },
          {
            "text": "enroll_enabled = false",
            "lineNumber": 296
          },
          {
            "text": "verify_enabled = false",
            "lineNumber": 297
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 298
          },
          {
            "text": "# Configure MFA via Phone Messaging",
            "lineNumber": 299
          },
          {
            "text": "[auth.mfa.phone]",
            "lineNumber": 300
          },
          {
            "text": "enroll_enabled = false",
            "lineNumber": 301
          },
          {
            "text": "verify_enabled = false",
            "lineNumber": 302
          },
          {
            "text": "otp_length = 6",
            "lineNumber": 303
          },
          {
            "text": "template = \"Your code is {{ .Code }}\"",
            "lineNumber": 304
          },
          {
            "text": "max_frequency = \"5s\"",
            "lineNumber": 305
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 306
          },
          {
            "text": "# Configure MFA via WebAuthn",
            "lineNumber": 307
          },
          {
            "text": "# [auth.mfa.web_authn]",
            "lineNumber": 308
          },
          {
            "text": "# enroll_enabled = true",
            "lineNumber": 309
          },
          {
            "text": "# verify_enabled = true",
            "lineNumber": 310
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 311
          },
          {
            "text": "# Use an external OAuth provider. The full list of providers are: &#96;apple&#96;, &#96;azure&#96;, &#96;bitbucket&#96;,",
            "lineNumber": 312
          },
          {
            "text": "# &#96;discord&#96;, &#96;facebook&#96;, &#96;github&#96;, &#96;gitlab&#96;, &#96;google&#96;, &#96;keycloak&#96;, &#96;linkedin_oidc&#96;, &#96;notion&#96;, &#96;twitch&#96;,",
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "text": "# &#96;twitter&#96;, &#96;x&#96;, &#96;slack&#96;, &#96;spotify&#96;, &#96;workos&#96;, &#96;zoom&#96;.",
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "[auth.external.apple]",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "text": "enabled = false",
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {
            "text": "client_id = \"\"",
            "lineNumber": 317
          },
          {
            "text": "# DO NOT commit your OAuth provider secret to git. Use environment variable substitution instead:",
            "lineNumber": 318
          },
          {
            "text": "secret = \"env(SUPABASE_AUTH_EXTERNAL_APPLE_SECRET)\"",
            "lineNumber": 319
          },
          {
            "text": "# Overrides the default auth redirectUrl.",
            "lineNumber": 320
          },
          {
            "text": "redirect_uri = \"\"",
            "lineNumber": 321
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.394857794046402

        "contents": "# For detailed configuration reference documentation, visit:\n# https://supabase.com/docs/guides/local-development/cli/config\n# A string used to distinguish different Supabase projects on the same host. Defaults to the\n# working directory name when running &#96;supabase init&#96;.\nproject_id = \"Tappka\"\n\n[api]\nenabled = true\n# Port to use for the API URL.\nport = 54321\n# Schemas to expose in your API. Tables, views and stored procedures in this schema will get API\n# endpoints. &#96;public&#96; and &#96;graphql_public&#96; schemas are included by default.\nschemas = [\"public\", \"graphql_public\"]\n# Extra schemas to add to the search_path of every request.\nextra_search_path = [\"public\", \"extensions\"]\n# The maximum number of rows returns from a view, table, or stored procedure. Limits payload size\n# for accidental or malicious requests.\nmax_rows = 1000\n\n[api.tls]\n# Enable HTTPS endpoints locally using a self-signed certificate.\nenabled = false\n# Paths to self-signed certificate pair.\n# cert_path = \"../certs/my-cert.pem\"\n# key_path = \"../certs/my-key.pem\"\n\n[db]\n# Port to use for the local database URL.\nport = 54322\n# Port used by db diff command to initialize the shadow database.\nshadow_port = 54320\n# Maximum amount of time to wait for health check when starting the local database.\nhealth_timeout = \"2m\"\n# The database major version to use. This has to be the same as your remote database's. Run &#96;SHOW\n# server_version;&#96; on the remote database to check.\nmajor_version = 17\n\n[db.pooler]\nenabled = false\n# Port to use for the local connection pooler.\nport = 54329\n# Specifies when a server connection can be reused by other clients.\n# Configure one of the supported pooler modes: &#96;transaction&#96;, &#96;session&#96;.\npool_mode = \"transaction\"\n# How many server connections to allow per user/database pair.\ndefault_pool_size = 20\n# Maximum number of client connections allowed.\nmax_client_conn = 100\n\n# [db.vault]\n# secret_key = \"env(SECRET_VALUE)\"\n\n[db.migrations]\n# If disabled, migrations will be skipped during a db push or reset.\nenabled = true\n# Specifies an ordered list of schema files that describe your database.",

        "contents": "file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n\n# Uncomment to configure local storage buckets\n# [storage.buckets.images]\n# public = false\n# file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n# allowed_mime_types = [\"image/png\", \"image/jpeg\"]\n# objects_path = \"./images\"\n\n# Allow connections via S3 compatible clients\n[storage.s3_protocol]\nenabled = true\n\n# Image transformation API is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.image_transformation]\n# enabled = true\n\n# Store analytical data in S3 for running ETL jobs over Iceberg Catalog\n# This feature is only available on the hosted platform.\n[storage.analytics]\nenabled = false\nmax_namespaces = 5\nmax_tables = 10\nmax_catalogs = 2\n\n# Analytics Buckets is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.analytics.buckets.my-warehouse]\n\n# Store vector embeddings in S3 for large and durable datasets\n# This feature is only available on the hosted platform.\n[storage.vector]\nenabled = false\nmax_buckets = 10\nmax_indexes = 5\n\n# Vector Buckets is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.vector.buckets.documents-openai]\n\n[auth]\nenabled = true\n# The base URL of your website. Used as an allow-list for redirects and for constructing URLs used\n# in emails.\nsite_url = \"http://localhost:3000\"\n# A list of *exact* URLs that auth providers are permitted to redirect to post authentication.\nadditional_redirect_urls = [\n  \"http://localhost:3000\",\n  \"https://localhost:3000\",\n  \"http://localhost:3000/auth/callback\",\n  \"https://localhost:3000/auth/callback\",\n  \"http://localhost:3000/auth/confirm-email-change\",\n  \"https://localhost:3000/auth/confirm-email-change\",\n  \"http://127.0.0.1:3000\",\n  \"https://127.0.0.1:3000\",\n  \"http://127.0.0.1:3000/auth/callback\",\n  \"https://127.0.0.1:3000/auth/callback\",\n  \"http://127.0.0.1:3000/auth/confirm-email-change\",\n  \"https://127.0.0.1:3000/auth/confirm-email-change\"\n]\n# How long tokens are valid for, in seconds. Defaults to 3600 (1 hour), maximum 604,800 (1 week).\njwt_expiry = 3600\n# JWT issuer URL.         "contents": "## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer Only)\n\n1. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n2. **No RLS or Functions**:\n\n   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "# Overrides the default auth redirectUrl.\nredirect_uri = \"\"\n# Overrides the default auth provider URL. Used to support self-hosted gitlab, single-tenant Azure,\n# or any other third-party OIDC providers.\nurl = \"\"\n# If enabled, the nonce check will be skipped. Required for local sign in with Google auth.\nskip_nonce_check = false\n# If enabled, it will allow the user to successfully authenticate when the provider does not return an email address.\nemail_optional = false\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\n# DO NOT commit your OAuth provider secret to git. Use environment variable substitution instead:\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n# Overrides the default auth redirectUrl.\nredirect_uri = \"\"\n# Overrides the default auth provider URL. Used to support self-hosted gitlab, single-tenant Azure,\n# or any other third-party OIDC providers.\nurl = \"\"\n# If enabled, the nonce check will be skipped. Required for local sign in with Google auth.\nskip_nonce_check = false\n# If enabled, it will allow the user to successfully authenticate when the provider does not return an email address.\nemail_optional = false\n\n# Allow Solana wallet holders to sign in to your project via the Sign in with Solana (SIWS, EIP-4361) standard.\n# You can configure \"web3\" rate limit in the [auth.rate_limit] section and set up [auth.captcha] if self-hosting.\n[auth.web3.solana]\nenabled = false\n\n# Use Firebase Auth as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.firebase]\nenabled = false\n# project_id = \"my-firebase-project\"\n\n# Use Auth0 as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.auth0]\nenabled = false\n# tenant = \"my-auth0-tenant\"\n# tenant_region = \"us\"\n\n# Use AWS Cognito (Amplify) as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.aws_cognito]\nenabled = false\n# user_pool_id = \"my-user-pool-id\"\n# user_pool_region = \"us-east-1\"\n\n# Use Clerk as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.clerk]\nenabled = false",

        "contents": "[auth.third_party.clerk]\nenabled = false\n# Obtain from https://clerk.com/setup/supabase\n# domain = \"example.clerk.accounts.dev\"\n\n# OAuth server configuration\n[auth.oauth_server]\n# Enable OAuth server functionality\nenabled = false\n# Path for OAuth consent flow UI\nauthorization_url_path = \"/oauth/consent\"\n# Allow dynamic client registration\nallow_dynamic_registration = false\n\n[edge_runtime]\nenabled = true\n# Supported request policies: &#96;oneshot&#96;, &#96;per_worker&#96;.\n# &#96;per_worker&#96; (default) — enables hot reload during local development.\n# &#96;oneshot&#96; — fallback mode if hot reload causes issues (e.g. in large repos or with symlinks).\npolicy = \"per_worker\"\n# Port to attach the Chrome inspector for debugging edge functions.\ninspector_port = 8083\n# The Deno major version to use.\ndeno_version = 2\n\n# [edge_runtime.secrets]\n# secret_key = \"env(SECRET_VALUE)\"\n\n[analytics]\nenabled = true\nport = 54327\n# Configure one of the supported backends: &#96;postgres&#96;, &#96;bigquery&#96;.\nbackend = \"postgres\"\n\n# Experimental features may be deprecated any time\n[experimental]\n# Configures Postgres storage engine to use OrioleDB (S3)\norioledb_version = \"\"\n# Configures S3 bucket URL, eg. &lt;bucket_name&gt;.s3-&lt;region&gt;.amazonaws.com\ns3_host = \"env(S3_HOST)\"\n# Configures S3 bucket region, eg. us-east-1\ns3_region = \"env(S3_REGION)\"\n# Configures AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID for S3 bucket\ns3_access_key = \"env(S3_ACCESS_KEY)\"\n# Configures AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY for S3 bucket\ns3_secret_key = \"env(S3_SECRET_KEY)\"",

        "contents": "Got it — here’s your **agent-optimized PRD template in Markdown (&#96;.md&#96;)** so you can reuse it for any product:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;markdown\n# PRD — [Product Name] MVP\n\n## 1. Overview\n[One-paragraph description of the product. Include key functionality, user interactions, and constraints like onboarding or payment.]\n\n---\n\n## 2. System Goals\n- [Goal 1: core outcome]\n- [Goal 2: workflows to automate or improve]\n- [Goal 3: monetization / business value]\n\n---\n\n## 3. Entities &amp; Schemas\n\n### Example: &#96;users&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate table users (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  email text unique not null,\n  phone text unique,\n  created_at timestamptz default now()\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Example: &#96;subscriptions&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate table subscriptions (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  user_id uuid references users(id),\n  stripe_customer_id text,\n  stripe_subscription_id text,\n  status text check (status in ('active','canceled','past_due')),\n  created_at timestamptz default now()\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\\[Add more entities as needed: &#96;messages&#96;, &#96;tasks&#96;, &#96;reminders&#96;, etc.]\n\n---\n\n## 4. Features\n\n### 4.1 Onboarding &amp; Payment\n\n* **Signup:** \\[Auth provider]\n* **Phone Verification:**\n\n  * Input: &#96;{ phone_number }&#96;\n  * Output: &#96;{ success: true, otp_sent: true }&#96;\n* **Payment:** Stripe/PayPal/etc → subscription sync\n\n### 4.2 Channels / Interfaces\n\n#### Web Chat\n\n* Input: &#96;{ user_id, message }&#96;\n* Output: &#96;{ status: \"stored\", assistant_reply }&#96;\n* Flow:\n\n  1. Store in DB\n  2. Call LLM agent with context\n  3.         "contents": "---\nname: Work Email Auth System\noverview: Build a robust authentication system using Supabase with Google OAuth, work email verification (@studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz)\ntodos:\n  - id: db-schema\n    content: Create Supabase migration for users and profiles tables (no RLS - access control in Next.js)\n    status: pending\n  - id: profile-verification\n    content: Implement database-based profile verification (no JWT claims)\n    status: pending\n  - id: supabase-config\n    content: Update supabase/config.toml (manual_linking, Google OAuth, security settings)\n    status: pending\n  - id: auth-constants\n    content: Create lib/constants/auth.ts with domain validation and role constants\n    status: pending\n  - id: server-actions\n    content: Create lib/actions/auth.ts with profile linking, verification, and access revocation\n    status: pending\n  - id: middleware-update\n    content: Update proxy.ts to query profiles table for verified user and access status\n    status: pending\n  - id: google-login\n    content: Create Google login button and rewrite login page\n    status: pending\n  - id: verify-email-flow\n    content: Create work email verification page with OTP and identity linking\n    status: pending\n  - id: pending-approval-page\n    content: Create pending approval page for users without profiles\n    status: pending\n  - id: access-revoked-page\n    content: Create access revoked page for users with revoked access\n    status: pending\n---\n\n# Work Email Authentication System\n\n## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        ",

        "contents": "name: Deploy Supabase Resources\n\non:\n  push:\n    branches:\n      - preview\n      - production\n    paths:\n      - 'supabase/**'\n  workflow_dispatch:\n    inputs:\n      environment:\n        description: 'Environment to deploy to'\n        required: true\n        type: choice\n        options:\n          - preview\n          - production\n\njobs:\n  deploy_staging:\n    environment: preview\n    runs-on: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404\n    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/preview' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &amp;&amp; github.event.inputs.environment == 'preview')\n    env:\n      SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN }}\n      PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.SUPABASE_PREVIEW_PROJECT_ID }}\n      \n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n      \n      - uses: supabase/setup-cli@v1\n        with:\n          version: latest\n          \n      - name: Link Supabase project\n        run: |\n          supabase link --project-ref $PROJECT_ID\n          \n      - name: Deploy database migrations\n        run: |\n          supabase db push\n          \n      - name: Deploy Edge Functions\n        continue-on-error: true\n        run: |\n          if [ -d \"supabase/functions\" ] &amp;&amp; [ \"$(ls -A supabase/functions)\" ]; then\n            echo \"Deploying Edge Functions...\"\n            supabase functions deploy\n          else\n            echo \"No Edge Functions found, skipping deployment.\"\n          fi\n          \n      - name: Deploy Edge Function secrets\n        continue-on-error: true\n        run: |\n          if [ -f \"supabase/.env.secrets\" ]; then\n            echo \"Deploying Edge Function secrets...\"\n            supabase secrets set --env-file supabase/.env.secrets\n          else\n            echo \"No secrets file found, skipping secrets deployment.\"\n          fi\n          \n  deploy_production:\n    environment: production\n    runs-on: blacksmith-2vcpu-ubuntu-2404\n    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/production' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &amp;&amp; github.event.inputs.environment == 'production')\n    env:\n      SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN }}",

→ User logged in with Google but hasn't verified work email\n- **Pending Approval**: Work email verified via OTP, but no profile exists with that email\n- **Verified &amp; Active**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NOT NULL AND profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **Access Revoked**: &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NOT NULL&#96;\n\n## Constants\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// lib/constants/auth.ts\nexport const ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS = [\n  'studenti.czu.cz',\n  'pef.czu.cz',\n] as const;\n\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt;         "contents": "└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n                           │\n                           ▼\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                        Supabase                                  │\n│  ┌─────────────────────┐  ┌─────────────────────────────────┐   │\n│  │   Auth Service      │  │         PostgreSQL              │   │\n│  │  - Google OAuth     │  │  - profiles table               │   │\n│  │  - OTP emails       │  │  - users table                  │   │\n│  │  - Session mgmt     │  │  - No RLS (Next.js handles)     │   │\n│  └─────────────────────┘  └─────────────────────────────────┘   │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\n## Simplicity Principles\n\n1. **Business logic in Next.js** - Server actions and middleware handle all rules\n2. **Supabase for storage only** - No hooks, no custom functions, no RLS, just tables\n3. **Minimal components** - Reuse shadcn/ui, no custom abstractions\n4. **Direct database queries** - Query profiles table for verification and access status\n5. **Admin-first onboarding** - Admin creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n\n# Common Traps to Avoid\n\n1. The auth flow will get stuck once the user is redirected back to the nextjs app from supabase.",

        "contents": "    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/production' || (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &amp;&amp; github.event.inputs.environment == 'production')\n    env:\n      SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN }}\n      PROJECT_ID: ${{ vars.SUPABASE_PRODUCTION_PROJECT_ID }}\n      \n    steps:\n      - uses: actions/checkout@v4\n      \n      - uses: supabase/setup-cli@v1\n        with:\n          version: latest\n          \n      - name: Link Supabase project\n        run: |\n          supabase link --project-ref $PROJECT_ID\n          \n      - name: Deploy database migrations\n        run: |\n          supabase db push\n          \n      - name: Deploy Edge Functions\n        continue-on-error: true\n        run: |\n          if [ -d \"supabase/functions\" ] &amp;&amp; [ \"$(ls -A supabase/functions)\" ]; then\n            echo \"Deploying Edge Functions...\"\n            supabase functions deploy\n          else\n            echo \"No Edge Functions found, skipping deployment.\"\n          fi\n          \n      - name: Deploy Edge Function secrets\n        continue-on-error: true\n        run: |\n          if [ -f \"supabase/.env.secrets\" ]; then\n            echo \"Deploying Edge Function secrets...\"\n            supabase secrets set --env-file supabase/.env.secrets\n          else\n            echo \"No secrets file found, skipping secrets deployment.\"\n          fi",

      "codeBlock": {

          "endPosition": {

        },
        "contents": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Users table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth)\n-- Note: Synced via Next.js server actions, not database triggers\ncreate table public.users (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  email text not null,\n  name text,\n  picture text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\n-- Role enum for profiles (authorization)\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\n-- Focus: Authentication and authorization only\ncreate table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  removed_access timestamptz,  -- null = active, set = revoked\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\n-- Indexes for auth queries\ncreate index profiles_user_id_idx on public.profiles(user_id);\ncreate index profiles_work_email_idx on public.profiles(work_email);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Entity Relationships\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────┐       ┌─────────────────┐\n│   auth.users    │       │    profiles     │\n│  (Supabase)     │       │  (Auth only)    │\n├─────────────────┤       ├─────────────────┤\n│ id (uuid)       │◄──┐   │ id (uuid)       │\n│ email (google)  │   │   │ name            │\n│ ...auth fields  │   └───│ user_id (1:1)   │",

        "contents": "import { cookies } from \"next/headers\";\n\n/**\n * Especially important if using Fluid compute: Don't put this client in a\n * global variable. Always create a new client within each function when using\n * it.\n */\nexport async function createClient() {\n  const cookieStore = await cookies();\n\n  return createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return cookieStore.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          try {\n            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n              cookieStore.set(name, value, options),\n            );\n          } catch {\n            // The &#96;setAll&#96; method was called from a Server Component.\n            // This can be ignored if you have proxy refreshing\n            // user sessions.\n          }\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control\n\n**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/rules/writing-supabase-edge-functions.mdc",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 23
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 95
          }
        },
        "contents": "9. To set other environment variables (ie. secrets) users can put them in a env file and run the &#96;supabase secrets set --env-file path/to/env-file&#96;\n10. A single Edge Function can handle multiple routes. It is recommended to use a library like Express or Hono to handle the routes as it's easier for developer to understand and maintain. Each route must be prefixed with &#96;/function-name&#96; so they are routed correctly.\n11. File write operations are ONLY permitted on &#96;/tmp&#96; directory. You can use either Deno or Node File APIs.\n12. Use &#96;EdgeRuntime.waitUntil(promise)&#96; static method to run long-running tasks in the background without blocking response to a request. Do NOT assume it is available in the request / execution context.\n\n## Example Templates\n\n### Simple Hello World Function\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\ninterface reqPayload {\n  name: string\n}\n\nconsole.info('server started')\n\nDeno.serve(async (req: Request) =&gt; {\n  const { name }: reqPayload = await req.json()\n  const data = {\n    message: &#96;Hello ${name} from foo!&#96;,\n  }\n\n  return new Response(JSON.stringify(data), {\n    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Connection: 'keep-alive' },\n  })\n})\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Example Function using Node built-in API\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto'\nimport { createServer } from 'node:http'\nimport process from 'node:process'\n\nconst generateRandomString = (length) =&gt; {\n  const buffer = randomBytes(length)\n  return buffer.toString('hex')\n}\n\nconst randomString = generateRandomString(10)\nconsole.log(randomString)\n\nconst server = createServer((req, res) =&gt; {\n  const message = &#96;Hello&#96;\n  res.end(message)\n})\n\nserver.listen(9999)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Using npm packages in Functions\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport express from 'npm:express@4.18.2'\n\nconst app = express()\n\napp.get(/(.*)/, (req, res) =&gt; {\n  res.send('Welcome to Supabase')\n})\n\napp.listen(8000)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Generate embeddings using built-in @Supabase.ai API\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nconst model = new Supabase.ai.Session('gte-small')\n\nDeno.serve(async (req: Request) =&gt; {\n  const params = new URL(req.url).searchParams",
        "signatures": {},

        "contents": "# Tappka\n\nTappka as the app all-in-one web app for Tiimiakatemia Prague.\n\n## Features\n\n- [ ] Authentication\n- [ ] Room booking\n- [ ] Essay Bank\n\n# Links\n\n## Publicly available\n- [Tappka](https://tiimi.cz)\n- [Tappka preview](https://preview.tiimi.cz)\n\n## Locally available when running the project\n- [Tappka locally](http://localhost:3000)\n- [Supabase locally](http://localhost:54323)\n- [Supabase mail locally](http://localhost:54324)\n\n## Other links\n\n- [Blacksmith](https://app.blacksmith.sh/tiimiakatemiapragueit/runs/jobs) - CI/CD for the project\n- [Supabase](https://supabase.com/dashboard/org/zjdqjjekgwwysjkouxpf) - Database for the project\n- [Vercel](https://vercel.com/spirit-of-taps-projects/tappka) - Hosting for the project\n- [Cloudflare DNS](https://dash.cloudflare.com/09d0b565479ef597d4c1bfa2062078b5/tiimi.cz/dns/records) - DNS for the project\n- [Axiom](https://app.axiom.co/spirit-of-tap-9eje) - Logging for the project\n\n# Language\n\nThe project is written in english and will be written in english for better llm compatibility.\nAll czech should be just in localization files.\n\n# Local Development\n\n## Setup\n\n1. Install git if already not installed - https://git-scm.com/install/\n2. Install node.js v24.x with pnpm 10.x if already not installed - https://nodejs.org/en/download/\n3. Install pnpm v10.x if you didn't choose it in the previous step\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install -g pnpm@10.28.1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. Clone the repository \n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit clone https://github.com/tappka/tappka.git\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n5. Navigate to the project directory - \n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd tappka\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Running the project after setup\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\npnpm install &amp;&amp; pnpm dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe project will be available at [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)\n\n\n# Supabase\n\nSupabase database is developed locally and synced automatically whenever pushed. See [.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml](.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml) for more details.\nSupabase Auth needs to be configured both on the project itself and in the local development environment.\nMake sure that the project can run without setting up any environment variables, this is so that we can get new T's to start vibecoding without them giving up.",

        "contents": "// scripts/setup-env.js\nimport { execSync } from 'child_process';\nimport fs from 'fs';\nimport path from 'path';\nimport { fileURLToPath } from 'url';\nimport { dirname } from 'path';\n\nconst __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);\nconst __dirname = dirname(__filename);\n\n// Key mapping from supabase status to Next.js env vars\nconst keyMapping = {\n  API_URL: 'NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL',\n  ANON_KEY: 'NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY',\n  PUBLISHABLE_KEY: 'NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY',\n  SERVICE_ROLE_KEY: 'SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY',\n};\n\n/**\n * Parses environment variables from a string content\n * Handles both KEY=value and KEY=\"value\" formats\n * @param content - The content string to parse\n * @returns Object mapping keys to values\n */\nconst parseEnvContent = (content) =&gt; {\n  const envVars = {};\n  for (const line of content.split('\\n')) {\n    const trimmed = line.trim();\n    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith('#')) {\n      continue;\n    }\n    const match = trimmed.match(/^([^=]+)=(.*)$/);\n    if (match) {\n      const key = match[1].trim();\n      let value = match[2].trim();\n      // Remove quotes if present\n      if ((value.startsWith('\"') &amp;&amp; value.endsWith('\"')) || \n          (value.startsWith(\"'\") &amp;&amp; value.endsWith(\"'\"))) {\n        value = value.slice(1, -1);\n      }\n      envVars[key] = value;\n    }\n  }\n  return envVars;\n};\n\n/**\n * Formats environment variables back to .env file format\n * @param envVars - Object mapping keys to values\n * @returns Formatted string content\n */",

        "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm() {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Sends OTP code to the provided email\n   * Uses updateUser to add email identity to the current authenticated user\n   * This is the correct way to link an email identity to an existing OAuth account\n   */\n  const handleSendOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Validate email format\n      if (!email || !email.includes(\"@\")) {\n        setError(\"Please enter a valid email address\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Use updateUser to add email identity to existing authenticated user\n      // This sends a verification link to the email address\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // Note: This adds the email as a secondary identity, not changing the primary email\n      const { data: updateData, error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser(\n        {\n          email: email.trim(),\n        },\n        {\n          emailRedirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/confirm-email-change&#96;,\n        },\n      );\n\n      if (updateError) {\n        // If email already exists, that's actually fine - it means it might already be linked\n        // or we need to handle it differently\n        if (updateError.message?.includes(\"already registered\")) {\n          setError(\"This email is already registered. Please use a different email or sign in with that email.\");\n        } else {\n          setError(updateError.message || \"Failed to send OTP code\");\n        }\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Move to OTP verification step\n      setStep(\"otp\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n}",

Implemented PKCE flow with a custom email template. Summary:

1. **Created custom email template** (`supabase/templates/email_change.html`) that uses `token_hash` instead of `code`
2. **Updated config.toml** to use the custom template for email change
3. **Updated route handler** to use `verifyOtp` with `token_hash` instead of `exchangeCodeForSession` with `code`
4. **Removed `emailRedirectTo`** from `updateUser` since the template includes the URL

The template uses `{{ .TokenHash }}` and `{{ .SiteURL }}`, which Supabase provides. The route handler now uses `verifyOtp` with `token_hash`, which works with PKCE flow without requiring the code verifier to be stored.

**Next steps:**
1. Restart your Supabase instance to load the new template configuration:
   ```bash
   supabase stop
   supabase start
   ```

2. Test the flow — when you call `updateUser`, the email will use the custom template with `token_hash`, and clicking the link will work without the PKCE code verifier error.

The email link will now be: `http://localhost:3000/auth/confirm-email-change?token_hash=...&type=email_change`

This should resolve the PKCE code verifier error since we're using `token_hash` verification instead of code exchange.

            "text": "enabled = false",

          },
          {
            "text": "account_sid = \"\"",

          },
          {
            "text": "message_service_sid = \"\"",
            "lineNumber": 290
          },
          {
            "text": "# DO NOT commit your Twilio auth token to git. Use environment variable substitution instead:",
            "lineNumber": 291
          },
          {
            "text": "auth_token = \"env(SUPABASE_AUTH_SMS_TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN)\"",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 293
          },
          {
            "text": "# Multi-factor-authentication is available to Supabase Pro plan.",
            "lineNumber": 294
          },
          {
            "text": "[auth.mfa]",
            "lineNumber": 295
          },
          {
            "text": "# Control how many MFA factors can be enrolled at once per user.",
            "lineNumber": 296
          },
          {
            "text": "max_enrolled_factors = 10",
            "lineNumber": 297
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 298
          },
          {
            "text": "# Control MFA via App Authenticator (TOTP)",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 300
          },
          {
            "text": "enroll_enabled = false",

          },
          {
            "text": "verify_enabled = false",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 303
          },
          {
            "text": "# Configure MFA via Phone Messaging",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "enroll_enabled = false",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "otp_length = 6",

          },
          {

          },
          {
            "text": "max_frequency = \"5s\"",
            "lineNumber": 310
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 311
          },
          {
            "text": "# Configure MFA via WebAuthn",

          },
          {
            "text": "# [auth.mfa.web_authn]",
            "lineNumber": 313
          },
          {
            "text": "# enroll_enabled = true",
            "lineNumber": 314
          },
          {
            "text": "# verify_enabled = true",
            "lineNumber": 315
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 316
          },
          {

          {

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./docs/prompting-help/feature.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
