          }
        },
        "contents": "Got it — here’s your **agent-optimized PRD template in Markdown (&#96;.md&#96;)** so you can reuse it for any product:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;markdown\n# PRD — [Product Name] MVP\n\n## 1. Overview\n[One-paragraph description of the product. Include key functionality, user interactions, and constraints like onboarding or payment.]\n\n---\n\n## 2. System Goals\n- [Goal 1: core outcome]\n- [Goal 2: workflows to automate or improve]\n- [Goal 3: monetization / business value]\n\n---\n\n## 3. Entities &amp; Schemas\n\n### Example: &#96;users&#96;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate table users (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  email text unique not null,\n  phone text unique,\n  created_at timestamptz default now()\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Example: &#96;subscriptions&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate table subscriptions (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  user_id uuid references users(id),\n  stripe_customer_id text,\n  stripe_subscription_id text,\n  status text check (status in ('active','canceled','past_due')),\n  created_at timestamptz default now()\n);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\\[Add more entities as needed: &#96;messages&#96;, &#96;tasks&#96;, &#96;reminders&#96;, etc.]\n\n---\n\n## 4. Features\n\n### 4.1 Onboarding &amp; Payment\n\n* **Signup:** \\[Auth provider]\n* **Phone Verification:**\n\n  * Input: &#96;{ phone_number }&#96;\n  * Output: &#96;{ success: true, otp_sent: true }&#96;\n* **Payment:** Stripe/PayPal/etc → subscription sync\n\n### 4.2 Channels / Interfaces\n\n#### Web Chat\n\n* Input: &#96;{ user_id, message }&#96;\n* Output: &#96;{ status: \"stored\", assistant_reply }&#96;\n* Flow:\n\n  1. Store in DB\n  2. Call LLM agent with context\n  3. Save + return assistant reply\n\n#### SMS (Twilio example)\n\n* Input:\n\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;json\n  { \"From\": \"+12025550123\", \"To\": \"+12025550999\", \"Body\": \"Remind me tomorrow at 9am\" }\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n* Output:\n\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;json\n  { \"status\": \"stored\", \"thread_id\": \"thread_123\", \"task_created\": true }\n  &#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n#### Email\n\n* Inbound: \\[Webhook flow]\n* Outbound: \\[Gmail API, SMTP, etc.]\n* Input: &#96;{ from, to, subject, body }&#96;\n* Output: &#96;{ status: \"sent\", message_id }&#96;\n\n### 4.3 Assistant Capabilities\n\n* **Calendar**\n\n  * Input: &#96;{ action, title, time, attendees }&#96;",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "Got it — here’s your **agent-optimized PRD template in Markdown (&#96;.md&#96;)** so you can reuse it for any product:",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;markdown",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "text": "# PRD — [Product Name] MVP",
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "text": "## 1. Overview",
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "[One-paragraph description of the product. Include key functionality, user interactions, and constraints like onboarding or payment.]",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "## 2. System Goals",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "text": "- [Goal 1: core outcome]",
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "- [Goal 2: workflows to automate or improve]",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "- [Goal 3: monetization / business value]",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "## 3. Entities &amp; Schemas",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "### Example: &#96;users&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "text": "create table users (",
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "  email text unique not null,",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "  phone text unique,",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "text": "  created_at timestamptz default now()",
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": ");",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "text": "### Example: &#96;subscriptions&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sql",
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "create table subscriptions (",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "  user_id uuid references users(id),",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "text": "  stripe_customer_id text,",
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "  stripe_subscription_id text,",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "text": "  status text check (status in ('active','canceled','past_due')),",
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "  created_at timestamptz default now()",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "text": ");",
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "\\[Add more entities as needed: &#96;messages&#96;, &#96;tasks&#96;, &#96;reminders&#96;, etc.]",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "---",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "## 4. Features",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4.1 Onboarding &amp; Payment",
            "lineNumber": 49
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 50
          },
          {
            "text": "* **Signup:** \\[Auth provider]",
            "lineNumber": 51
          },
          {
            "text": "* **Phone Verification:**",
            "lineNumber": 52
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 53
          },
          {
            "text": "  * Input: &#96;{ phone_number }&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 54
          },
          {
            "text": "  * Output: &#96;{ success: true, otp_sent: true }&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 55
          },
          {
            "text": "* **Payment:** Stripe/PayPal/etc → subscription sync",
            "lineNumber": 56
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 57
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4.2 Channels / Interfaces",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Web Chat",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "* Input: &#96;{ user_id, message }&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "* Output: &#96;{ status: \"stored\", assistant_reply }&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "* Flow:",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "  1. Store in DB",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "  2. Call LLM agent with context",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "  3. Save + return assistant reply",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "#### SMS (Twilio example)",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "* Input:",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "  &#96;&#96;&#96;json",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "text": "  { \"From\": \"+12025550123\", \"To\": \"+12025550999\", \"Body\": \"Remind me tomorrow at 9am\" }",
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "  &#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "text": "* Output:",
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "  &#96;&#96;&#96;json",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "text": "  { \"status\": \"stored\", \"thread_id\": \"thread_123\", \"task_created\": true }",
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "  &#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "#### Email",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "* Inbound: \\[Webhook flow]",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "text": "* Outbound: \\[Gmail API, SMTP, etc.]",
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "* Input: &#96;{ from, to, subject, body }&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "text": "* Output: &#96;{ status: \"sent\", message_id }&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "text": "### 4.3 Assistant Capabilities",
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "* **Calendar**",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "  * Input: &#96;{ action, title, time, attendees }&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 94
          }
        ]
      },

        "contents": "[db.migrations]\n# If disabled, migrations will be skipped during a db push or reset.\nenabled = true\n# Specifies an ordered list of schema files that describe your database.\n# Supports glob patterns relative to supabase directory: \"./schemas/*.sql\"\nschema_paths = []\n\n[db.seed]\n# If enabled, seeds the database after migrations during a db reset.\nenabled = true\n# Specifies an ordered list of seed files to load during db reset.\n# Supports glob patterns relative to supabase directory: \"./seeds/*.sql\"\nsql_paths = [\"./seed.sql\"]\n\n[db.network_restrictions]\n# Enable management of network restrictions.\nenabled = false\n# List of IPv4 CIDR blocks allowed to connect to the database.\n# Defaults to allow all IPv4 connections. Set empty array to block all IPs.\nallowed_cidrs = [\"0.0.0.0/0\"]\n# List of IPv6 CIDR blocks allowed to connect to the database.\n# Defaults to allow all IPv6 connections. Set empty array to block all IPs.\nallowed_cidrs_v6 = [\"::/0\"]\n\n[realtime]\nenabled = true\n# Bind realtime via either IPv4 or IPv6. (default: IPv4)\n# ip_version = \"IPv6\"\n# The maximum length in bytes of HTTP request headers. (default: 4096)\n# max_header_length = 4096\n\n[studio]\nenabled = true\n# Port to use for Supabase Studio.\nport = 54323\n# External URL of the API server that frontend connects to.\napi_url = \"http://127.0.0.1\"\n# OpenAI API Key to use for Supabase AI in the Supabase Studio.\nopenai_api_key = \"env(OPENAI_API_KEY)\"\n\n# Email testing server. Emails sent with the local dev setup are not actually sent - rather, they\n# are monitored, and you can view the emails that would have been sent from the web interface.\n[inbucket]\nenabled = true\n# Port to use for the email testing server web interface.\nport = 54324\n# Uncomment to expose additional ports for testing user applications that send emails.\n# smtp_port = 54325\n# pop3_port = 54326\n# admin_email = \"admin@email.com\"\n# sender_name = \"Admin\"\n\n[storage]\nenabled = true\n# The maximum file size allowed (e.g. \"5MB\", \"500KB\").\nfile_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n\n# Uncomment to configure local storage buckets\n# [storage.buckets.images]\n# public = false\n# file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer Only)\n\n1. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n2. **No RLS or Functions**:\n\n   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "## Supabase Configuration Changes",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 195
          },

            "text": "Update [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):",

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "[auth.email]",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "enable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup",

          },

            "text": "enable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "text": "[auth.external.google]",
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "text": "enabled = true",
            "lineNumber": 208

          {
            "text": "client_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"",

          },
          {
            "text": "secret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"",

          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 211

          {
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "text": "### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)",
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "text": "All verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:",
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id",

            "text": "- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "text": "- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)",
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "text": "This approach:",

            "lineNumber": 222

            "text": "- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)",

            "text": "- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification",
            "lineNumber": 225
          },
          {
            "text": "- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)",
            "lineNumber": 226

          {
            "lineNumber": 227
          },
          {
            "text": "## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP",
            "lineNumber": 228
          },

            "lineNumber": 229
          },
          {
            "text": "The project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:",

            "lineNumber": 231
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally",

        "contents": "│ email (google)  │   │   │ name            │\n│ ...auth fields  │   └───│ user_id (1:1)   │\n└─────────────────┘       │ work_email      │\n                          │ role (enum)     │\n                          │ removed_access  │\n                          │ removed_access_by│──┐\n                          │ created_at      │  │\n                          │ updated_at      │  │\n                          └─────────────────┘  │\n                                    ▲          │\n                                    └──────────┘ (self-reference)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Verification Logic\n\n- **Unverified**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NULL&#96; → User logged in with Google but hasn't verified work email\n- **Pending Approval**: Work email verified via OTP, but no profile exists with that email\n- **Verified &amp; Active**: &#96;profiles.user_id IS NOT NULL AND profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **Access Revoked**: &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NOT NULL&#96;\n\n## Constants\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// lib/constants/auth.ts\nexport const ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS = [\n  'studenti.czu.cz',\n  'pef.czu.cz',\n] as const;\n\nexport const isValidWorkEmailDomain = (email: string): boolean =&gt; {\n  const domain = email.split('@')[1]?.toLowerCase();\n  return ALLOWED_WORK_EMAIL_DOMAINS.includes(domain as any);\n};\n\n// Profile roles (matches database enum)\nexport const PROFILE_ROLES = ['student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin'] as const;\nexport type ProfileRole = typeof PROFILE_ROLES[number];\n\n// Role hierarchy for permission checks\nexport const ROLE_HIERARCHY: Record&lt;ProfileRole, number&gt; = {\n  student: 0,\n  team_leader: 1,\n  coach: 2,\n  admin: 3,\n} as const;\n\nexport const hasMinimumRole = (userRole: ProfileRole, requiredRole: ProfileRole): boolean =&gt; {\n  return ROLE_HIERARCHY[userRole] &gt;= ROLE_HIERARCHY[requiredRole];\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \"@/components/verify-email-form\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Email verification page\n * Users must link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\n */\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has email identity\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/protected\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-sm\"&gt;\n        &lt;VerifyEmailForm /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has an email identity linked\n * (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n * @returns true if user has an email identity, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasEmailIdentity(): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (error || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth)\n  // User identities include: email, google, etc.\n  // We need at least one email identity\n  const identities = user.identities || [];\n  \n  // Check if any identity is an email identity (not OAuth)\n  return identities.some(\n    (identity) =&gt; identity.provider === \"email\"\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { cn } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport {\n  Card,\n  CardContent,\n  CardDescription,\n  CardHeader,\n  CardTitle,\n} from \"@/components/ui/card\";\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\";\nimport { Label } from \"@/components/ui/label\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\nexport function ForgotPasswordForm({\n  className,\n  ...props\n}: React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef&lt;\"div\"&gt;) {\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState(\"\");\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleForgotPassword = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const supabase = createClient();\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      // The url which will be included in the email. This URL needs to be configured in your redirect URLs in the Supabase dashboard at https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/_/auth/url-configuration\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, {\n        redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/update-password&#96;,\n      });\n      if (error) throw error;\n      setSuccess(true);\n    } catch (error: unknown) {\n      setError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"An error occurred\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className={cn(\"flex flex-col gap-6\", className)} {...props}&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm() {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Sends OTP code to the provided email\n   * Uses updateUser to add email identity to the current authenticated user\n   * This is the correct way to link an email identity to an existing OAuth account\n   */\n  const handleSendOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Validate email format\n      if (!email || !email.includes(\"@\")) {\n        setError(\"Please enter a valid email address\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Use updateUser to add email identity to existing authenticated user\n      // This sends a verification link to the email address\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // Note: This adds the email as a secondary identity, not changing the primary email\n      const { data: updateData, error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser(\n        {\n          email: email.trim(),\n        },\n        {\n          emailRedirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/confirm-email-change&#96;,\n        },\n      );\n\n      if (updateError) {\n        // If email already exists, that's actually fine - it means it might already be linked\n        // or we need to handle it differently\n        if (updateError.message?.includes(\"already registered\")) {\n          setError(\"This email is already registered. Please use a different email or sign in with that email.\");\n        } else {\n          setError(updateError.message || \"Failed to send OTP code\");\n        }\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Move to OTP verification step\n      setStep(\"otp\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/work_email_auth_system_467a2b18.plan.md",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control\n\n**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",

          },
          {
            "text": "        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]",
            "lineNumber": 58
          },
          {
            "text": "        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]",
            "lineNumber": 59
          },
          {
            "text": "    end",
            "lineNumber": 60
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 61
          },
          {
            "text": "    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]",
            "lineNumber": 62
          },
          {
            "text": "        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]",
            "lineNumber": 63
          },
          {
            "text": "        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}",
            "lineNumber": 64
          },
          {
            "text": "        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]",
            "lineNumber": 65
          },
          {
            "text": "        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}",
            "lineNumber": 66
          },
          {
            "text": "        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]",
            "lineNumber": 67
          },
          {
            "text": "        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]",
            "lineNumber": 68
          },
          {
            "text": "    end",
            "lineNumber": 69
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 70
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 71
          },
          {
            "text": "## Validation Flow",
            "lineNumber": 72
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 73
          },
          {
            "text": "**Two-stage validation:**",
            "lineNumber": 74
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 75
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Client-side: Immediate feedback",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Checked on every request via middleware",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "Two tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",
            "lineNumber": 96
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.25531241297721863

        "contents": "└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n                           │\n                           ▼\n┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐\n│                        Supabase                                  │\n│  ┌─────────────────────┐  ┌─────────────────────────────────┐   │\n│  │   Auth Service      │  │         PostgreSQL              │   │\n│  │  - Google OAuth     │  │  - profiles table               │   │\n│  │  - OTP emails       │  │  - users table                  │   │\n│  │  - Session mgmt     │  │  - No RLS (Next.js handles)     │   │\n│  └─────────────────────┘  └─────────────────────────────────┘   │\n└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n\n## Simplicity Principles\n\n1. **Business logic in Next.js** - Server actions and middleware handle all rules\n2. **Supabase for storage only** - No hooks, no custom functions, no RLS, just tables\n3. **Minimal components** - Reuse shadcn/ui, no custom abstractions\n4. **Direct database queries** - Query profiles table for verification and access status\n5. **Admin-first onboarding** - Admin creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n\n# Common Traps to Avoid\n\n1. The auth flow will get stuck once the user is redirected back to the nextjs app from supabase.",

      "codeBlock": {

        "contents": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Users table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth)\n-- Note: Synced via Next.js server actions, not database triggers\ncreate table public.users (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  email text not null,\n  name text,\n  picture text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\n-- Role enum for profiles (authorization)\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\n-- Focus: Authentication and authorization only\ncreate table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  removed_access timestamptz,  -- null = active, set = revoked\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\n-- Indexes for auth queries\ncreate index profiles_user_id_idx on public.profiles(user_id);\ncreate index profiles_work_email_idx on public.profiles(work_email);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Entity Relationships\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────┐       ┌─────────────────┐\n│   auth.users    │       │    profiles     │\n│  (Supabase)     │       │  (Auth only)    │\n├─────────────────┤       ├─────────────────┤\n│ id (uuid)       │◄──┐   │ id (uuid)       │\n│ email (google)  │   │   │ name            │\n│ ...auth fields  │   └───│ user_id (1:1)   │",

        "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,",

        "contents": "# tenant_region = \"us\"\n\n# Use AWS Cognito (Amplify) as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.aws_cognito]\nenabled = false\n# user_pool_id = \"my-user-pool-id\"\n# user_pool_region = \"us-east-1\"\n\n# Use Clerk as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.clerk]\nenabled = false\n# Obtain from https://clerk.com/setup/supabase\n# domain = \"example.clerk.accounts.dev\"\n\n# OAuth server configuration\n[auth.oauth_server]\n# Enable OAuth server functionality\nenabled = false\n# Path for OAuth consent flow UI\nauthorization_url_path = \"/oauth/consent\"\n# Allow dynamic client registration\nallow_dynamic_registration = false\n\n[edge_runtime]\nenabled = true\n# Supported request policies: &#96;oneshot&#96;, &#96;per_worker&#96;.\n# &#96;per_worker&#96; (default) — enables hot reload during local development.\n# &#96;oneshot&#96; — fallback mode if hot reload causes issues (e.g. in large repos or with symlinks).\npolicy = \"per_worker\"\n# Port to attach the Chrome inspector for debugging edge functions.\ninspector_port = 8083\n# The Deno major version to use.\ndeno_version = 2\n\n# [edge_runtime.secrets]\n# secret_key = \"env(SECRET_VALUE)\"\n\n[analytics]\nenabled = true\nport = 54327\n# Configure one of the supported backends: &#96;postgres&#96;, &#96;bigquery&#96;.\nbackend = \"postgres\"\n\n# Experimental features may be deprecated any time\n[experimental]\n# Configures Postgres storage engine to use OrioleDB (S3)\norioledb_version = \"\"\n# Configures S3 bucket URL, eg. &lt;bucket_name&gt;.s3-&lt;region&gt;.amazonaws.com\ns3_host = \"env(S3_HOST)\"\n# Configures S3 bucket region, eg. us-east-1\ns3_region = \"env(S3_REGION)\"\n# Configures AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID for S3 bucket\ns3_access_key = \"env(S3_ACCESS_KEY)\"\n# Configures AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY for S3 bucket\ns3_secret_key = \"env(S3_SECRET_KEY)\"",

        "contents": "# Tappka\n\nTappka as the app all-in-one web app for Tiimiakatemia Prague.\n\n## Features\n\n- [ ] Authentication\n- [ ] Room booking\n- [ ] Essay Bank\n\n# Links\n\n## Publicly available\n- [Tappka](https://tiimi.cz)\n- [Tappka preview](https://preview.tiimi.cz)\n\n## Locally available when running the project\n- [Tappka locally](http://localhost:3000)\n- [Supabase locally](http://localhost:54323)\n- [Supabase mail locally](http://localhost:54324)\n\n## Other links\n\n- [Blacksmith](https://app.blacksmith.sh/tiimiakatemiapragueit/runs/jobs) - CI/CD for the project\n- [Supabase](https://supabase.com/dashboard/org/zjdqjjekgwwysjkouxpf) - Database for the project\n- [Vercel](https://vercel.com/spirit-of-taps-projects/tappka) - Hosting for the project\n- [Cloudflare DNS](https://dash.cloudflare.com/09d0b565479ef597d4c1bfa2062078b5/tiimi.cz/dns/records) - DNS for the project\n- [Axiom](https://app.axiom.co/spirit-of-tap-9eje) - Logging for the project\n\n# Language\n\nThe project is written in english and will be written in english for better llm compatibility.\nAll czech should be just in localization files.\n\n# Local Development\n\n## Setup\n\n1. Install git if already not installed - https://git-scm.com/install/\n2. Install node.js v24.x with pnpm 10.x if already not installed - https://nodejs.org/en/download/\n3. Install pnpm v10.x if you didn't choose it in the previous step\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\nnpm install -g pnpm@10.28.1\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n4. Clone the repository \n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ngit clone https://github.com/tappka/tappka.git\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n5. Navigate to the project directory - \n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd tappka\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Running the project after setup\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\npnpm install &amp;&amp; pnpm dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe project will be available at [http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)\n\n\n# Supabase\n\nSupabase database is developed locally and synced automatically whenever pushed. See [.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml](.github/workflows/deploy-supabase.yml) for more details.\nSupabase Auth needs to be configured both on the project itself and in the local development environment.\nMake sure that the project can run without setting up any environment variables, this is so that we can get new T's to start vibecoding without them giving up.",

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\n\n/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const type = searchParams.get(\"type\") as EmailOtpType | null;\n\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  if (token_hash &amp;&amp; type) {\n    const supabase = createServerClient(\n      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n      {\n        cookies: {\n          getAll() {\n            return request.cookies.getAll();\n          },\n          setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt;\n              request.cookies.set(name, value),\n            );\n            supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n              request,\n            });\n            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt;\n              supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options),\n            );\n          },\n        },\n      },\n    );\n\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n      type,\n      token_hash,\n    });\n\n    if (!error)\n}",

**Restart Supabase** for the template to take effect:

```bash

```

After restarting, when you call `updateUser` to change an email, Supabase will use your custom template with `token_hash` instead of the default template with `code`. The email link will be:

`http://localhost:3000/auth/confirm-email-change?token_hash=...&type=email_change`

This should resolve the PKCE code verifier error since we're using `token_hash` verification instead of code exchange.
